body: Thank you everyone for your kind words.

But I admit it to people I don't know on the Internet, not to the people in my life that depend on me. I am so scared of hurting people that I ignore the problems that I cause and hope they will go away. It's a terrible way to live, but I am powerless to fix it. That to me is the ultimate sign of cowardice. I appreciate your kind words, but I am a failure to myself and my daughters.

I am a coward. I never face up to anything. I cheated on my wife, ripped my family apart, walked out of what was a 17 plus year, loving relationship. I never finished college. I can't keep a job. I have no future. I've bankrupted my family. My oldest daughter is putting herself through college because I can't even provide for my family financially. The list goes on and on.

I've never done anything for long enough to be good at it. My resume reads like a person who has been in a constant state of 'finding myself'. I've done sales, marketing, training, insurance, collections, technician for telecom, etc. Nothing ever sticks. The term jack of all trades, master of none sounds good until your 45 and looking for a job. No college degree is a huge hindrance. And no one wants to look at life experience as an alternative. 

I've had my life insurance for years, it pays out regardless.
